name: io.github.giancarloerra/januscope
description: Local MCP proxy for tool restrictions, response redaction, audit logs, and database schema context.

packageArguments.name: --config
packageArguments.description: Bundled policy preset name (for example postgres-crystaldba) or absolute path to a YAML/JSON policy. The target MCP's prerequisites and environment variables must also be configured; inspect them with januscope lenses show <name>.

environmentVariables.name: JANUSCOPE_USER
environmentVariables.description: Optional identity attribution stamped onto every audit record. Free-form operator identifier (email, employee id) for SIEM joins. Omitted from records when unset.

environmentVariables.name: JANUSCOPE_TEAM
environmentVariables.description: Optional org / team / cost-centre identifier stamped onto every audit record. Omitted when unset.

environmentVariables.name: JANUSCOPE_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Optional client-side correlation id stamped onto every audit record. Useful for cross-process tracing.
